title: Exploring with five senses
summary: Review five senses, their body parts and how they help us learn about the world.
keyIdeas: We study five senses: sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch.
Eyes, ears, nose, tongue and skin help gather information.
We feel touch through skin all over our body.

basicKnowledge: A. Cultura científica › La vida en nuestro planeta
A. Cultura científica › Iniciación en la actividad científica

activities.prompt: Match each sense to its body part.
activities.explanation: Eyes, ears, nose, tongue and skin gather different kinds of information.

activities.prompt: We feel touch through skin all over our body.
activities.explanation: Skin on different body parts can feel cold, warmth and gentle touch, not just our hands.

activities.prompt: Hugo hears the school bell. Which sense does he use?
activities.explanation: Hearing lets us notice sounds around us, such as the school bell.
activities.hint: We use it to listen to sounds.

activities.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct sense.
activities.explanation: Our nose helps us notice smells.
activities.sentence: Aisha smells a garden flower using her sense of ___.

activities.prompt: Sort these examples by the main sense used.
activities.explanation: We hear sounds with our ears and notice smells with our nose.

activities.prompt: Three friends talk about senses. Who makes a mistake?
activities.explanation: Omar is wrong. We feel touch through all our skin, not just our hands.
activities.hint: Think about which body parts have skin.
options: Lucía: Our tongue helps us taste
Omar: We can only feel touch with our hands
Mateo: Our eyes help us see colours

activities.prompt: Lucía eats an apple with her nose blocked. What will happen?
activities.explanation: Smell works with taste. With a blocked nose, flavours are harder to recognise.
options: The apple's flavour will seem much weaker
The apple will suddenly change colour

activities.prompt: In the dark, Adrián feels two towels to find the dry one. Which sense does he use?
activities.explanation: Touch helps us notice whether something is dry, wet, smooth or rough.

activities.prompt: Listening to very loud music helps care for our ears.
activities.explanation: Very loud sounds can damage hearing. Use a comfortable, low volume.

activities.prompt: Read about the walk and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: We can use our senses to explore and enjoy nature.
activities.title: A countryside walk
activities.text: Nerea and Wei walk in the countryside. Nerea hears birds singing. Wei smells flowers beside the path. Then Nerea strokes a soft dog. Wei tastes a delicious, sweet plum.

questions.prompt: Which sense does Nerea use to hear the birds?
questions.explanation: Nerea hears the birdsong with her sense of hearing.

questions.prompt: Which sense tells Wei that the plum is sweet?
questions.explanation: Taste, using the tongue, helps us notice sweet, salty and sour flavours.
